note: Maps CI jobs to local tiers for GromCodebase tools/local_green.py. No command
strings live here; commands are read live from the workflow YAML, so a new CI
job that is not classified below is a hard error (drift detector).
Tiers: fast (cheap), full (adds the compile matrix), skip (never local; reason required).

skip_reasons.ci.yml/fresh-walk: Fresh-clone stranger's walk clones the repo again; run manually via tools/fresh-walk.ps1 before a release.

notes_on_fidelity: windows-msvc needs a vcvars64 developer environment; tools/local-ci.ps1 is the canonical local equivalent and writes out/local-ci-<Config>.json.
The sandbox Vulkan smoke inside windows-msvc runs the real renderer locally (owner GPU) and SKIPs on GPU-less runners.
